headline: Receiver's quarterly update, policy updates, and superintendent search update.
summary: The meeting covers a Chair's policy subcommittee update, the Receiver's quarterly report and policy updates including the Wellness Policy and Civil Law Enforcement Policy, and an update on the superintendent search. It also includes an accountability data presentation and a report from the student representative.
